item_fields_note: derived items: key+title+spec required, where spec is a repo-relative docs/specs/<slug>.md reference to a confirmed spec. Optional story, acceptance_criteria (list), epic, skill (frontend|backend|fullstack), order, depends_on (list of story keys — edges must resolve; drives `forge roadmap parallel`). epics: id+title required; optional objective, source_refs. assignee/status are grooming/lifecycle state — never set by derive/import.
